title: Adjunction for the closed-site lift
statement:
The functor $v$ is left adjoint to $u$, with $uv$ canonically the identity,
for the functors of [def-exc-closed-site-lift].

proof.text: For the precise functors of [def-exc-closed-site-lift], apply [lem-weil-pbc-affine-closed-site-functor-properties]. Extract its full and faithful witnesses for v, together with an adjunction v ⊣ u. This is an existing stronger statement, so the affine-spectrum and algebra-lift Hom calculations need not be repeated in this module.

For a fully faithful left adjoint the unit of its adjunction is an isomorphism. Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Adjunction.unit_isIso_of_L_fully_faithful to the extracted adjunction. Concretely, faithfulness makes each unit component monic, while fullness lifts the counit to a section of that component by the triangle identity. Thus every unit component is invertible, and their inverses are natural. Pair the adjunction with this IsIso proof to obtain the asserted existential statement.
